subject: Invite rendering failure in mobile mail clients — Accept button points to wrong anchor
messages: From: Emma Li To: Marissa Cole Cc: support@hanacraft.com Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700 Subject: Problem accepting supplier invite from mobile (Gmail Android) Hi Marissa, We received the supplier portal invite for HanaCraft and tried to accept it from my phone (Gmail app on Android). When I tap the blue "Accept invite" button the browser opens but it jumps to the wrong section of the page (the PO view) and shows "Link expired". If I open the same email on desktop the button works fine. I attached a screenshot from my phone showing the button area — it looks like the Accept button isn't actually linked correctly in the mobile preview. We need this supplier onboarding completed by Friday to meet our PO schedule. Thanks, Emma Li Vendor Operations | HanaCraft Supplies emma.li@hanacraft.com +1 415-555-0123 Attachments: - accept-button-screenshot-android.png (image/png) From: Marissa Cole To: Emma Li Cc: Ben Carter , Laura Bennett Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier invite from mobile (Gmail Android) Hi Emma — sorry you're hitting this. Thanks for the screenshot, that's helpful. Quick questions to help us reproduce: - Is that the Gmail app on Android (not a webview)? - Can you forward the original invite email as-is (not a screenshot) to support@redwood.ai so we can inspect the raw HTML? I've looped in Ben (infra) to triage HTML/rendering issues and Laura (onboarding) so she can pause any manual follow-ups while we investigate. We'll prioritize this and follow up with a short remediation plan. Best, Marissa Cole Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference marissa_cole@redwood.ai On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 09:12 AM Emma Li wrote: > Hi Marissa, > > We received the supplier portal invite for HanaCraft and tried to accept it from my phone (Gmail app on Android). When I tap the blue "Accept invite" button the browser opens but it jumps to the wrong section of the page (the PO view) and shows "Link expired"... From: Ben Carter To: Marissa Cole , Emma Li Cc: Laura Bennett Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:42:00 -07:00 Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier invite from mobile (Gmail Android) — initial triage Marissa / Emma — I pulled the raw HTML from the invite (thanks for forwarding, Emma) and reproduced on a Pixel 6 (Gmail app). Observations: 1) The invite template contains two CTA buttons rendered as Accept and View PO. In a handful of email clients we saw that the autogenerated HTML sanitizer collapses duplicate id attributes or rewrites anchors; in this case the sanitizer is generating a duplicate id value due to our template partials rendering the same id for two different components in mobile preview. 2) When the Gmail mobile client rewrites or collapses attributes, the fragment/anchor resolution can attach to the second anchor on the page (PO link). That explains why the browser lands at the PO fragment and our token validation then returns expired. Repro steps I used: forwarded original email -> open in Gmail app -> tap Accept -> observe redirect to /purchase/po/12345 -> token validation fail. Short remediation options: - Regenerate invites with unique id attributes for CTAs (fast, server-side template fix). - As a stop-gap, send a one-click accept URL in the top-level plaintext portion of the email (bypass client-side rendering). I've attached: email-html-snippet.html (sanitized copy we received) and accept-link-server-log.txt (showing the token and redirect target when tapped from mobile). I'll prepare a hotfix branch to suffix CTA ids with the invite token (unique-per-email) and run a quick QA matrix against common mobile clients (Gmail Android, Gmail iOS, Outlook mobile). ETA: patch + QA in ~24 hours. Ben Engineering — Platform Reliability | Redwood Inference ben_carter@redwood.ai Attachments: - email-html-snippet.html (text/html) - accept-link-server-log.txt (text/plain) > On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 10:05 AM Marissa Cole wrote: > > Hi Emma — sorry you're hitting this. Thanks for the screenshot, that's helpful. From: Marissa Cole To: Emma Li Cc: Ben Carter , Laura Bennett Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:43:00 -07:00 Subject: Fix deployed — regenerate invites and quick follow-up Emma — quick update and sorry again for the interruption. What we changed: - Deployed patch SUP-2314 that appends a unique suffix to CTA id attributes in the invite template so mobile client sanitizers no longer collapse them. - Regenerated the pending HanaCraft invites and resent them at 15:20 PT today. - Added a plaintext accept URL at the top of the email as a fallback for older clients. Can you please check the latest invite from your phone when you get a moment? If it still fails, please reply with the time and I'll escalate immediately. Thanks for the patience — Laura will follow up to confirm the PO timeline once you accept. Best, Marissa Cole Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference marissa_cole@redwood.ai -----Forwarded message from Emma Li ----- From: Emma Li To: Marissa Cole Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:04:00 -0700 Subject: Re: Problem accepting supplier invite from mobile (Gmail Android) Thanks, Marissa — I just tried the new invite on my phone and it worked. The accept flow opened correctly and I could finish onboarding. Appreciate the rapid fix. Emma
